title: On the equivalence of unitarization prescriptions for the Sommerfeld enhancement
summary: The annihilation of self-interacting dark matter with long-range interactions can be significantly enhanced at low velocities through the Sommerfeld effect. At special points in parameter space, where near-zero-energy resonances exist in the spectrum of the theory, the standard calculation of this enhancement appears to violate unitarity. Recently, several approaches have been proposed to regulate this behavior, some introducing explicit ultraviolet (UV) scales and others not, raising the question of whether these prescriptions are consistent.
